name: express-service-platform
description: 快递综合服务平台 monorepo（保留快递100 Java SDK）

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:api
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @express-platform/shared-types && npm run build -w @express-platform/api-client && npm run build -w @express-platform/ui-components
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @express-platform/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w @express-platform/api-client && npm run typecheck -w @express-platform/ui-components && npm run typecheck -w @express-platform/api
